audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].side reads "Skill" while win[3] reads "Naafiri" — the two layers render different answers for Levels 4-5.
audit.why: Naafiri holds the lane through level 5: Eviscerate (E) is a 450-range dash on 11s at rank 1 and Anivia has no peel until Glacial Storm. The packet chart and the content layer both say Naafiri.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side -> Naafiri, rating aligned to the neighbouring rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls Hounds' Pursuit "a fifteen-second invitation". It is 110/95/80 seconds.
audit.why: Naafiri's R cooldown is 110 at rank 1 per the kit file, and it recasts once for a shield. Undercounting it by 7x tells the player to fear a window that is actually enormous.
audit.corrected: Restated with the real number; the spike order (Lost Chapter, level 6, Seraph's/RoA) is otherwise right.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text calls Hounds' Pursuit her "sidestep tool" and never states the two decisive interactions: Crystallize terrain denies both her dashes, and The Call of the Pack / Eviscerate / Hounds' Pursuit all make her untargetable through your commit.
audit.why: Crystallize is flagged terrain (blocks paths and dashes); Naafiri's E and R are both flagged dash, and W, E and R all carry the untargetable flag. Anivia's E doubles on a chilled target, so the wall-then-Frostbite sequence is the real punish. Riot's text for Eviscerate heals her packmates, not Naafiri herself.
audit.corrected: Named the wall-versus-dash interaction, the untargetable frames, and kept anti-heal out of the advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: No warning that a full Q-R-E commit can be eaten by untargetability.
audit.why: W is 26s at rank 1 and E is 11s; both blank a timed burst if you throw into them.
audit.corrected: Added to the don'ts and to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: The egg ruins his one-shot plan — but only if your Q and wall make the second kill attempt lethal for HIM.
edits.after: The egg ruins her one-shot plan — but only if Crystallize sits across the dash she needs for the second attempt.

edits.before: Naafiri wins by landing Hounds’ Pursuit, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Naafiri wins by opening with Eviscerate every 11s, going untargetable through your answer, and finishing with a lock-on Hounds’ Pursuit.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Naafiri burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Trade only with Eviscerate on cooldown: land Flash Frost first, then Frostbite for the doubled chill damage and step back before her 11s dash returns.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Naafiri walks straight at you.
edits.after: Dumping Q and E into The Call of the Pack — she is untargetable through it, and you are the one standing there with nothing when she lands.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. It governs your forward steps. - W Crystallize spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Eviscerate: 11s at rank 1 and only 450 range — that gap is your whole safety margin. - The Call of the Pack: 26s of untargetable, so never burst into it. - Hounds' Pursuit: 110s and it recasts for a shield. - Crystallize (17s) answers all three dashes.

edits.before: Carry by controlling space — storm and wall decide where fights happen, and your stun decides who dies first inside them.
edits.after: Carry by making distance expensive: her longest reach is a 900-range dagger, so storm the ground she must cross and wall the dash line she picks.

edits.before: If Naafiri opens the score, reset expectations and respect Hounds’ Pursuit doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with R wave-clear and stay relevant through zone control.
edits.after: If Naafiri opens the score, never stand outside tower with Crystallize down — a fed 450-range dash closes instantly. Farm with R wave-clear and save the wall for her commit, not her poke.

edits.before: Ahead, the lane is a prison: storm every wave, wall Naafiri away from the comeback farm, and rotate first to every river fight with your stun loaded.
edits.after: Ahead, the lane is a prison: storm every wave, wall Naafiri off the comeback farm, and rotate first to river fights — with Hounds' Pursuit on 110s she cannot follow you.

edits.before: Q only — last-hit with autos and save the stun strictly for his step-ups. Your egg is NOT a license to int level 1.
edits.after: Q only — last-hit with autos and hold the stun for her walk-up; packmates make her level 1 auto trade real. The egg is NOT a license to int.

edits.before: Q-E online — a landed stun now means a real chunk. Trade only when his engage tool is down; your mana hates wasted rotations.
edits.after: Q-E online — a landed stun now means a real chunk. Trade only with Eviscerate on its 11s; your mana hates rotations spent on untargetable frames.

edits.before: Full basic kit: W cuts the lane in half. Wall his path to the wave when your jungler shadows — free stun setups.
edits.after: Full basic kit: Crystallize is terrain, so it stops Eviscerate mid-dash. Drop it behind her when your jungler shadows — free stun setups.

edits.before: Naafiri burns Hounds’ Pursuit on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Naafiri burns Hounds' Pursuit on nothing — that is 110 seconds at rank 1 with no lock-on left.

edits.before: That’s Naafiri’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Flash Frost down is her cue: Eviscerate closes 450 units and the packmates arrive with her.

edits.before: Rylai's slow stacking makes her engage attempts nearly suicidal, and your wall can separate her from her packmates entirely.
edits.after: Rylai's slow stacking makes her engage suicidal, and Crystallize is terrain — it stops Eviscerate and Hounds' Pursuit mid-dash outright.

edits.before: She continues running you down with pack pressure and no peel tool from you
edits.after: Eviscerate every 11s runs you down and you have no peel until 6

edits.before: Your slow stacking and wall shut down her dash-reliant kit late
edits.after: Crystallize terrain stops both her dashes; slow stacking finishes it

edits.before: Hold Crystallize to wall her off after she commits Dash
edits.after: Hold Crystallize to cut Eviscerate off mid-dash

edits.before: Punish your Flash Frost cooldown with a full dive
edits.after: Punish your Flash Frost cooldown with Eviscerate

notes: Naafiri is female; tldr, winCon, phases[0-2].why and several report entries said "his/him" — fixed where I edited. Two data issues: (1) dosFull[2].d claimed a fifteen-second cooldown on Hounds' Pursuit, actually 110/95/80. (2) The kit file's needsAntiheal flag on Eviscerate misfires — Riot's own text says the dash "recall[s] her packmates and fully heal[s] them", i.e. it heals the pack, not Naafiri, so I did not write anti-heal advice and left report[8]'s existing anti-heal line alone rather than assert either way.
